hab: A paddock with one orange stone in it
bio: A calf with a blaze of orange on its forehead that clutches one orange pebble and will not, under any circumstances, let it go.
A navy bull with glowing orange eyes and curled horns. It buys the dip in a storm, and then the next dip, and keeps every pebble it has ever bought.
note: There is no second best, it says, holding the first.
